the **Tool Gateway**](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-03971c3e77cb). **Roadmap & Hype:** **Teknium** [scoped recent improvements as a Windows-only *subset* of a larger batch of changes](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-f42a25486ccf), and his [cryptic 'What dat means 👀' reply](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-9e255d992e86) (18.7k views, 19 replies) is fueling real anticipation for an upcoming Hermes announcement — good 'coming soon' hooks, tempered only by his standard ['when it's ready' non-timeline](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-cf834c566206). distinction](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-6b8093ef1002)), while **Teknium** [playfully confirmed Hermes was running his personal identity/agent while he was on vacation](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-5e98cda64363) — an organic real-world trust signal the community loved. **Tips & Support:** Practical guidance included [running the **Hermes update** terminal command](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-6b20bea16273) and [enabling plugins under the capabilities page](/?date=2026-10-03&category=social#item-85ed75950b2a). **Merch & Brand:** The forgiving of the updater hiccup given the visible pace of development.

items.title: @maxkolysh We support multi-account handling so one Hermes install can authenticate and use several ...
items.content:
@maxkolysh We support multi-account handling so one Hermes install can authenticate and use several Google accounts. Tokens are stored separately per email address, with selection via an --account flag, an environment variable, or a default-account setting. 

We also support multi-calendar access within accounts and related actions such as searching, reading, sending, and creating events, set up with a Google Cloud project and OAuth credentials.
